note: Confirmed: both left Ajax for AC Milan on Bosman frees in the summer of 1996.

q: Which Belgian club did Ajax let Noa Lang go to in October 2020, first on loan?
note: Confirmed: October 2020, an initial loan with an obligation to buy by 1 July 2021.

q: Davy Klaassen rejoined Ajax in September 2024 from which club?
sub: His third spell in Amsterdam.
note: DUPLICATE, internal. The answer is Inter Milan, which is also the answer to the row asking which Italian club he joined from Ajax in 2023. Same player, same club, one leg each way, so each row hands over the other.

q: Erik ten Hag came back to Dutch football in February 2026 as technical director at which club?
note: Confirmed: appointed Twente's sporting director on 1 February 2026 on a deal to 2028.

q: Which German club sacked Erik ten Hag in September 2025 after three competitive matches?
note: OFF BRIEF. Bayer Leverkusen sacking a Dutch coach, with no Dutch club and no league content anywhere in the row. Save it for the coaches-abroad mode. The ten Hag return to Twente survives on its own.

q: Ajax signed the goalkeeper Andre Onana in 2015 from which club's academy?
note: Confirmed: Ajax took him from Barcelona's academy, announced January 2015, joined that July.

q: Which American club did Hirving Lozano leave PSV for at the start of 2025?
sub: PSV had now sold him twice.
note: Confirmed: signing announced June 2024, officially joined San Diego FC on 1 January 2025, PSV's second sale of him.

q: Ajax left Sebastien Haller off a squad list in February 2021. What did the mistake cost him?
a: His place in the Europa League knockout rounds
note: Confirmed: Ajax mistakenly left him off the Europa League knockout squad list in February 2021 and he could not play in the competition.

q: Telstar came up in 2025 after 47 years away and stayed up on the final day. Which fellow promoted club did they beat?
note: Confirmed: Telstar won 2-1 away at Volendam on the final day and finished 14th on 37 points.

sub: The KNVB warned a replay could open more than 130 other matches to challenge.

Sub reworded because it credited the reasoning to the court rather than the KNVB. Confidence upgraded from likely to sure.

q: PSV were crowned champions on 5 April 2026 without kicking a ball. What handed them the title?
a: Feyenoord could only draw 0-0 with Volendam

note: The 2-1 win over Aston Villa is confirmed as a home game in the Europa League league phase, but the venue is not confirmed on the club page and small grounds are often swapped for UEFA ties. Dropped the town rather than risk it.

q: Inter got Andre Onana from Ajax for nothing in 2022. What did they sell him for a year later?

q: Vitesse lost their professional licence in the summer of 2025. How were they playing again by September?
a: They won an appeal in court and got the licence back
note: Confirmed: licence revoked 11 June 2025, appeal lost 31 July, then a turbo-urgent court ruling on 3 September 2025 gave it back and they played on in the Eerste Divisie with a twelve point deduction.

q: Heracles Almelo finished bottom of the 2025-26 Eredivisie on 19 points, but won one match 8-2. Against whom?
